records.text: Peyton McCormick's grandfather was Colonel Pete McCormick, and her father, Lieutenant Colonel Alan McCormick, was stationed at Fort Huachuca.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: There is Peyton McCormick. Her grandfather is Colonel Pete McCormick. Her father is Lieutenant Colonel Alan McCormick, once stationed at Fort Huachuca.

verification.notes: Pete McCormick's obituary confirms he was a retired Army colonel and Peyton McCormick's grandfather, and identifies her father as Allen L. McCormick IV. It does not establish the father's lieutenant-colonel rank or a Fort Huachuca posting.

sources.title: Colonel A. L. McCormick III, U.S. Army (Ret.) obituary
sources.relevance: Family obituary establishes Pete McCormick's rank, granddaughter Peyton, and son Allen, while not documenting the claimed Fort posting.

records.text: Peyton was also, by the way, Miss Teen USA in 2006,
records.speaker: Candace Owens
